_about: The Plenix brand (batch 278): the owner's brand kit, unedited, and what each file is for. To update the brand, replace a file (or point an entry at a new file) and run node build-app.js: build-brand.js regenerates the mark's stylesheet (components/Brand/brand.css) and favicon.svg, and services/auth/brand-css.js the sign-in page.
name: Plenix
